findings.title: Silence action opens no drawer for list rules
findings.body: This list item passes only `promRule` to `RuleActionsButtons`, so `rulerRule` is undefined. The menu can still show Silence based on the Prometheus rule abilities, but the silence drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. Clicking Silence therefore sets state without displaying a drawer, leaving the action unusable.

findings.title: Pause and delete actions disappear from Grafana rule menus
findings.body: The new list path supplies no `rulerRule`, but `AlertRuleMenu` renders both Pause and Delete only when a ruler rule is present. Consequently, Grafana rules in this list lose those actions even when the Prometheus-based ability checks say the user is allowed to perform them. This removes actions that were available in the previous list view.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: The previous `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` checked `rule.group` for federated rule groups before allowing edits or deletes. It now delegates to this helper, which hardcodes `isFederated` to false and no longer has the group metadata needed for that check. As a result, rules in federated Mimir groups can be presented as editable or deletable even though those operations were previously disabled as unsupported.

findings.title: Rule links no longer preserve the return destination
findings.body: The previous Grafana rule list item added a `returnTo` URL when linking to a rule's details; this replacement omits it. Opening a rule from a filtered or grouped list therefore loses the originating list location, so the details page's return navigation cannot reliably restore the user's prior view and filters.
